Spending 24 Hours in Worlds Largest Bounce House vs Hide and Seek Challenge to the Exposing Project Zorgo YouTube channel, Daniel planned to find out more about his past through going to his old high school. Regina can create a hack that confused the news network and made it seem like school was canceled. This enabled the Spy Ninjas to get to the school, however, Vy pointed out that it'd be a really bad idea to find their way inside, especially if school was actually in session! Thankfully, the ninjas took some of the clues from the last video and determined that they could find something important if they check out the baseball field. The Spy ninjas thought they would stumble upon something leading to the mysterious safe, but instead, they run onto PZ9 and another hacker, who challenges them to some baseball challenges! Is it worth it to learn more about Daniel? What are his most interesting secrets? Is he really a baseball wizard? Thank you for watching my funny entertainment comedy vlog videos in 2019!
